Today's headlines:

  • Today marks Tim Cook's final day as Apple's CEO, with Ternus set to take over the role
  • Phil Schiller steps back, no longer overseeing the App Store and Apple events
  • Read the full internal memo Tim Cook sent to Apple staff on his final day as CEO
